'''Cream''' {{J|イエローゼリー|Ierō Zerī|Yellow Jelly}} in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a gelatinous monster related to the [[Jelly (Tactics Advance)|Jelly]] and [[Ice Flan (Tactics Advance)|Ice Flan]]. It has a ridiculously high Defense stat but is susceptible to magic, barring that of the [[Thunder (ability)|Thunder]] element, which the Cream absorbs.

{{See|Yellow Jelly}}
